topic: Did the November 2025 US-China arrangement remove China's critical-mineral controls?
disagreement: The White House (Nov 2025) said Chinese general licences meant 'de facto removal' of controls imposed since 2023, but in May and September 2026 it still reported rare-earth and critical-mineral shortages (naming yttrium, scandium, neodymium, indium), and the April 2025 rare-earth controls and Feb 2025 indium controls were not suspended by China's November 2025 announcements.
possible_reasons: commitment vs implementation: general licences promised but no Chinese general-licence notice found
scope: suspensions covered the Oct 2025 package and the US-specific ban, not the April 2025 rare-earth or Feb 2025 indium controls
rationale: The MOFCOM texts show which notices were suspended; the US fact sheets describe intentions and later outcomes.
remaining_uncertainty: Whether MOFCOM issued general licences and how many, and actual 2026 shipment volumes (GACC data not retrieved).

topic: Is the US-specific gallium/germanium measure a ban or a presumption of denial?
disagreement: USGS says China 'banned all exports of germanium to the United States' in December 2024; the MOFCOM text says such exports will 'in principle not be licensed' (原则上不予许可).
possible_reasons: definition: presumption of denial vs absolute ban
rationale: Primary legal text controls; in practice the effect may be close to a ban.
remaining_uncertainty: Whether any licences for US-bound Ga/Ge were granted Dec 2024-Nov 2025.

topic: Status of China's analog chip anti-dumping case
disagreement: The White House said China would terminate anti-dumping investigations targeting US chip-supply-chain companies; MOFCOM's lists as of 1 Oct 2026 show no termination notice for the analog chip case, whose normal deadline (13 Sep 2026) has passed.
possible_reasons: termination may have been unpublished or published elsewhere
case may have been extended (to 13 Mar 2027) without a listed notice
US description may not cover this case
remaining_uncertainty: Current legal status of the case; whether provisional or final duties exist.
